name: Palak Paneer
steps: Blanch spinach for 2 minutes, cool and grind to a smooth puree.
Heat oil, saute chopped onion until golden, add ginger-garlic paste and tomato.
Add masala and cook until oil separates, then stir in the spinach puree.
Add paneer cubes, simmer 5 minutes and serve hot.

name: Dal Tadka
steps: Wash dal and pressure cook with water and turmeric until soft.
Mash the dal lightly and simmer with chopped tomato and salt.
Heat ghee, fry sliced onion and masala to make the tadka.
Pour tadka over the dal and serve with rice or roti.

name: Chana Masala
steps: Soak chickpeas overnight and pressure cook until tender.
Saute onion in oil until brown, add tomato and masala.
Add the chickpeas with some cooking water and simmer 10 minutes.
Mash a few chickpeas to thicken the gravy and serve.

name: Vegetable Poha
steps: Rinse poha in a strainer and let it soften for 5 minutes.
Heat oil, cook diced potato and peas until tender.
Add onion and turmeric, then gently mix in the poha.
Steam for 2 minutes, add lemon juice and serve.

name: Besan Chilla
steps: Mix besan with water, salt and spices into a smooth batter.
Fold in finely chopped onion and tomato.
Spread a ladle of batter on a hot oiled pan.
Cook both sides until golden and serve with chutney.

name: Aloo Gobi
steps: Cut potato and cauliflower into medium pieces.
Saute onion in oil, add tomato and masala.
Add vegetables, cover and cook on low heat until soft.
Stir occasionally, finish with coriander and serve.

name: Paneer Bhurji
steps: Crumble the paneer with your hands.
Saute onion and capsicum in oil, add tomato and masala.
Add crumbled paneer and cook 3 to 4 minutes.
Garnish with coriander and serve with roti.

name: Chicken Curry
steps: Marinate chicken with curd, salt and half the masala for 15 minutes.
Brown onion in oil, add ginger-garlic paste and tomato.
Add chicken and remaining masala, cook covered on medium heat.
Cook until the chicken is fully done with no pink inside, then serve.

name: Egg Bhurji
steps: Beat the eggs with salt.
Saute onion and tomato in oil with masala.
Pour in the eggs and stir continuously until scrambled and fully set.
Serve hot with bread or roti.

name: Fish Curry
steps: Marinate fish pieces with salt and turmeric.
Saute onion in oil, add ginger-garlic paste, tomato and masala.
Add water to make a gravy and bring to a simmer.
Add the fish gently and cook 8 to 10 minutes until opaque and flaky.

name: Rajma Chawal
steps: Soak rajma overnight and pressure cook until very soft.
Saute onion, tomato and masala in oil to make the base.
Add rajma with its liquid and simmer 15 minutes.
Cook rice separately and serve together.

name: Vegetable Pulao
steps: Wash rice and soak for 15 minutes.
Heat ghee, fry onion and masala, add vegetables.
Add rice and 2 parts water, bring to a boil.
Cover and cook on low heat until the water is absorbed.

name: Moong Dal Khichdi
steps: Wash rice and moong dal together.
Heat ghee, add masala and diced potato.
Add rice, dal and water, then pressure cook for 3 whistles.
Mash lightly and serve with curd.

name: Aloo Paratha
steps: Knead atta with water into a soft dough.
Mash boiled potato with masala and salt for the filling.
Stuff dough balls with filling and roll out gently.
Cook on a hot pan with oil until golden on both sides.

name: Chana Chaat
steps: Use boiled chickpeas, soaking and boiling dry chickpeas first.
Mix with chopped onion and tomato.
Add chaat masala, lemon juice and salt.
Serve immediately.
